pins.name: D22
pins.label: GPIO22 (Button)
pins.notes: BOARD_USER_BUTTON - CONFIRMED onboard USER pushbutton, gated by default-CLOSED 'USER_BTN' solder jumper (docs.sparkfun.com beta hardware overview: "GPIO22 connects to the USER button"). Already carries a general D22 alias in this board's own pins_arduino.h; overridden here to button-only (drops the incorrectly-implied digital_output/pwm_output a plain alias would give), matching sparkfun_xrp_controller's GPIO36 button-tagging precedent.
